title: THE POWER-UP CHIP IS A HUD PLATE
why: His rule of 2026-10-14: new features are integrated and polished like the old. The power-up timer chip was its own flat dark box drawn by hand with a rail, in the smallest HUD type. It is now the line plate every other HUD line uses (rounded, with the 3 pixel rail in its power-up colour), with the name and the seconds in the HUD label size like the feed lines and the timer bar under the words. It blinks over its last three seconds as before.
now: The power-up chips are now HUD plates in the HUD label size.

edits.replacement: c.font=hudFS(TYPE.label); c.textAlign='left'; tot=-8*z;   // v16.xx (chips1): the HUD label size, as the feed and the panels (was micro)
x0=Math.round(W/2-tot/2); y0=Math.round(miny-28*z);   // v16.xx (chips1): 28 tall (was 24), the label size's row
